newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AUSTRALIAN STOCKS TO WATCH TODAY - AUG 8.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRALIAN STOCKS TO WATCH TODAY - AUG 8.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
* Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd A$17.44 (-0.55)

The second resignation in two days from the senior ranks of BHP's minerals division is likely to put further pressure on the company's shares. On Thursday, the head of BHP's iron ore unit, Geoff Wedlock, resigned, a day after the exit of minerals division chief, Dick Carter.

Australian tobacco group W.D. & H.O. Wills Holdings Ltd shares to be relisted on the stock exchange after it requested a 48-hour trading halt following the Federal government's announcement of a 200 percent increase in excise on tobacco products, Wills said. It said the excise change will lead to a A$500 million increase in total revenue collected by the Federal government, states and territories. Both companies have stopped selling their products.
Confusion surrounds drinks groups following the High Court ruling earlier this week over the state government's ability to collect tax on alcohol and tobacco.
Analysts said on Thursday they had downgraded expectations for soft drink bottler Coca-Cola Amatil Ltd, expressing concerns about returns from the bottlers European operations.

Transport and industrials services group hit a record high on Thursday after the release of latest results from its partner in the Chep pallet business, GKN Plc, which showed the Chep business had a strong outlook.
